scope: Read-only implementation audit plus separately bound stronger validation; no frozen driver/checker/model edits.

driver.empty_queue_preparation: Correctly restores captured SDK ingress pointer only after both rings drain and worker is HEADER. Output FIFO/raster pointer stays at its already drained position. HEADER_PRIME refreshes the synchronous input read after pointer relocation. Both initial pointers and zero extra host edges are recorded and verified by supplemental audit.
driver.published_word_logging: Pre-edge emit/write_ptr captured without mutation; post-edge RAM word read uses actual queue.size()-1, supporting both512 and2048-word variants. Supplemental audit sums every write/read pointer increment and requires exact equality with binary word count and final drain.
driver.gpu_observer_occupancy: Only change versus previously qualified observer: ring_words uses command_wrptr-ring_rdptr when that field exists. This measures raster/output FIFO rather than subtracting independent ingress/output pointers. Legacy model falls back to its original ring pointer. cpu_ring_full and unpublished metrics still describe ingress, so these have distinct meanings.
driver.input_bindings: Build/run verifies frozen model sources, generated headers/library, exact ELF, driver/observers, snapshot and guest segments. Supplemental audit additionally verifies capture/guest inventories and both baseline/candidate fixture+ELF identity.

checker_findings.issue: Raw0x56 payload equality plus only draw-time0x50 state could miss a load-time projection-state change.
checker_findings.resolution: Supplemental checker captures complete26-word object state at each vertex load, then compares that state for every referenced vertex. All three completed candidates pass.

checker_findings.issue: Original queued checker did not independently validate its supplied baseline, initial prepared queue record, import-sticky-error, final worker/math idle, or every published-word pointer increment.
checker_findings.resolution: Supplemental checker validates both baseline and candidate against the bound functional capture; checks those lifecycle conditions; all three candidates pass. Accepted raw START may wait pending while queued math owns FMA, which is legal; raw_active&&!raw_pending is forbidden with queued owner.

normalization_review: Only typed framebuffer-base/flip remapping, the proven initialized third-buffer clear, later integer s5 timestamp, unused vertex slots and redundant sticky state writes are permitted. Full images/depth/all buffer history, Surface pool, initial registers, all FP registers/FCSR, every effective draw payload/load-time projection/current material, raw LOAD/context writes and side effects remain exact.
large_fifo_scope: Only QUEUE_BITS9->11 in candidate GPU instantiation; ingress and wrap remain4096. Tests use actual unchanged worker plus BIM2/FMA/converters with2047 pressure and pointer wrap. No fit or area qualification; larger memory is a causal counterfactual.
